Class Camera

java.lang.Object
renderer.Camera
All Implemented Interfaces:
Cloneable
public class Camera extends Object implements Cloneable
Camera class representing a point of view in the 3D scene. It handles the creation of rays through the view plane pixels. * @author Project Assistant
